new_candidate.architecture: CNN, depthwise axial 2D context, height-4 pooling, 3-layer autoregressive Transformer decoder, 528-token vocabulary
new_candidate.training_lineage: Seeded from scratch then same IBEM lineage; 129303 crops / 480 training docs, 16899 / 60 validation docs; deterministic Typst conversion; no external teacher, synthetic or pretrained state claimed
new_candidate.positive: Publisher document-disjoint FP32 validation: exact match 92.6268% over 16899 crops; <=32 tokens 97.8519%; independently initialized 14,157,152 parameter CNN/axial 2D context/three-layer Transformer decoder. 129303 training crops from 480 documents; validation 60 other documents. Direct package-free Typst output, no pretrained external learned dependency.
new_candidate.negative: Publisher validation-selected checkpoint, held-out test unopened; 33–64 tokens 88.4282% below own 90% gate, display formulas 70.1197%, matrices and accents errors. Printed tight single crop only, not handwriting or page OCR. No matched incumbent test, hardware/clock/batch/latency/peak memory or independent replay. INT8 built-in probe parity only; full-domain INT8 evaluation not completed.

format_decision: FP32 transfer checkpoint retained; same-state INT8 ONNX encoder+decoder are runtime alternatives, not separate learned outcomes; no FP16/FP32 ONNX duplicate registration.
risk: No observed imminent removal or licensing transition. Rights remain act-specific; no unsafe or bypass ranking.
